decisions.statement: A row is the top row, a seat, or a subagent.
A row's children are rows of any kind.
A row names the page akasha has for that row or names none at all.
A row naming no page names no page in its tooltip and opens no page.
A subagent row says whether that subagent was stopped from the panel.
A click has the seat's id and the seat's name and nothing more.
The shape sits apart from its composer so either can land first.
A row is spelled here as every other tree the editor draws spells a row.

definition: the shape of a row the agent tree draws, and the shape a click on a seat carries
